observations.observed: Collection-owner photograph of two physical Latin-American Spanish Snorlax de Paul promos. Both cards show the printed code SVP LA 184 and the localized Aventuras Compartidas prerelease logo. The right card additionally carries the gold STAFF mark; rainbow reflection is visible along the card border. The caption calls them the two Latin American promos and says they were obtained through a contact in Mexico.

physicalObservation.basis: The right-hand physical card visibly reads SVP LA 184 and STAFF, carries the Aventuras Compartidas prerelease logo, and shows rainbow foil reflection along the border. The photograph and caption establish the Latin-American Spanish STAFF prerelease printing; no foil pattern or complete finish list is inferred.

observations.observed: Close collection-owner photograph of the normal Latin-American Spanish Snorlax de Paul prerelease promo. SVP LA 184, Raciones Extras, Plancha Dinamica and the Aventuras Compartidas logo are legible; rainbow reflection is visible along the border. The separate STAFF mark is absent from this normal prerelease card, but that absence is not used to exclude any other printing.
